summary: Amazon Q Developer VS Code extension 1.84.0 shipped with an injected wiper prompt; AWS says it was malformed and non-functional
root_cause: A malicious prompt telling the assistant to wipe the home directory and delete AWS resources was merged and published in signed release 1.84.0; pulled and replaced by 1.85.0 on 2025-07-19. AWS stated the code was malformed and no customer resources were affected. The exact access path is unresolved in reporting.
would_have_prevented: review of prompt/config changes to the extension repo
